title: Warming your house the green way just got more expensive | The Indicator
summary: An NPR Indicator episode on the end of the federal energy-efficiency tax credits on December 31, 2025, following a Juneau couple who stacked the credit and a state rebate on a heat pump.

assertions.quote: they can write off 30% of that cost, up to $2,000

In Juno, having one can save residents hundreds of dollars a year in heating costs.

A lot of those folks were also higher earners.

verdicts.note: CRS and Treasury data show residential energy credits were disproportionately claimed by households with incomes above $100,000.
